name: gitauto
description: Token-cheap Git delivery commands for Claude Code (on haiku) and pi, backed by bundled scripts. `/gitauto:new-branch` leaves main; `/gitauto:open-pr` opens a PR and waits for green CI; `/gitauto:ship` runs the full flow through merge, sync, cleanup, and an opt-in tag prompt. An expensive PR writer is used only for complex changes. `/gitauto:generate-readme` creates or updates the root README.md and DEVELOPMENT.md.
